name: HopL.io QR Share
author: Muller Digital Inc.

sections.description:
• Posts & Pages – a “HopL.io QR” column on the list tables and a box on the edit screen generate a short link + QR code for the item’s permalink.
  • Media – every attachment gets a “HopL.io QR” action (list view, details modal and Edit Media screen) that links straight to the file.
  • Any URL – the HopL.io › Generate QR Code page creates codes for arbitrary addresses.
  • Modal – view the QR, copy the short URL and embed shortcode, edit meta data, restyle the QR (colours, shape, gradient, logo) without changing the short URL, generate a brand-new code, download SVG/PNG/PDF, and open the tracking dashboard.
  • Tracking – connect the site to a free HopL.io admin account (created with the site admin email, or by pasting an existing API key). Codes generated before connecting are claimed automatically; the HopL.io › Dashboard page shows totals and per-code visits.
  • Access control – Settings › minimum role decides who can generate codes (administrators always can). Users can only generate codes for items they may edit.

Shortcodes

  • [hoplio_qr code="AB3D" size="200" link="yes" align="center"] – embeds the QR image linked to its short URL.
  • [hoplio_link code="AB3D" text="Scan me"] – renders a link to the short URL.

Configuration

The plugin always talks to HopL.io (hopl.io / admin.hopl.io) — this isn’t configurable, so nothing on your site can redirect it elsewhere.

Optional constant for wp-config.php:

  • HOPLIO_SSL_VERIFY – default true; set to false only for local stacks running these same hosts behind a self-signed certificate.

The hoplio_meta_box_post_types filter changes which post types get the edit-screen box (default: post, page).

Data

Codes are stored in the _hoplio_qr post meta (posts, pages, media) and the hoplio_custom_codes option (arbitrary URLs); QR SVGs are mirrored into wp-content/uploads/hopl-io-qr-share/. Uninstalling removes all of it.

External services

This plugin connects to the HopL.io service (hopl.io / admin.hopl.io), which generates and hosts the short links and QR codes it creates, and provides the visit tracking shown on the HopL.io › Dashboard page. HopL.io is operated by Muller Digital Inc., the same company that develops this plugin.

  • Generating a QR code/short link – whenever you generate or restyle a code (from the Posts/Pages/Media list, the edit-screen box, or HopL.io › Generate QR Code), the target URL, any optional meta-data labels you add, your chosen colours/shape, and an uploaded logo image (if any) are sent to admin.hopl.io so it can create the short link and render the QR code. This happens even before you connect a HopL.io account – codes work without one, they just aren’t tracked.
  • Connecting an account – if you choose to connect a free HopL.io account (HopL.io › Settings, or from the Dashboard page), the site admin’s email address, display name and site URL are sent to admin.hopl.io to create or verify that account. Codes generated before connecting are then claimed automatically.
  • Signing in to the HopL.io dashboard – when an administrator clicks Open dashboard or a code’s Tracking dashboard button, a signed, single-use sign-in token (containing the site’s HopL.io site ID, the admin’s WordPress user ID and email address, and the short code being opened) is sent to admin.hopl.io so the admin is signed in without a separate password. The first time, HopL.io emails a confirmation link before signing in.
  • Tracking dashboard – once connected, the HopL.io › Dashboard page requests visit totals and per-code statistics from admin.hopl.io for display in wp-admin.

No data is sent to HopL.io until you actively generate a code, connect an account, open or view the dashboard – the plugin makes no background or scheduled calls to the service.

HopL.io Terms of Service | HopL.io Privacy Policy
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • The modal’s Tracking dashboard button signs administrators in to HopL.io and opens that code’s statistics.
  • Dashboard sign-in links no longer expire if the page has been open for more than a minute.

1.0.5

  • QR SVGs are stored in uploads/hopl-io-qr-share/, protected by an empty index.php.
  • Sanitize the minimum role setting.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
